title: Apparently Claude is great at making music with an (emulated) N64 soundfont.
author: Dogbold
selftext:
So I'm having it make me a clone of Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue, one of my favorite childhood games as I've always loved playing in a "big" world as a tiny character. I'm wanting to add a lot to it, possibly more than the original it's inspired by.

Slowly making it one room at a time, but most additions are Claude's ideas. I have one room where Claude had the suggestion for the room as a laundry room. There's a clothesline with swinging clothes because of a fan, and when you turn on the washing machine it shakes and moves forward to let you climb up a towel to get up there.

The character is a toy 2 legged dragon that shoots fireballs instead of Buzz's laser. You will unlock more abilities as parts to the toy by progressing so you can backtrack for more "tokens" like a Metroidvania. 

But I asked for some music... and Claude definitely delivered. Especially track 4, the boss. Also do you think the guitar lead or clarinet lead is better for the house theme?

I'll make a main post about this later but I just wanted to share the music for this now since I thought it was pretty cool.
